title: Base Value
text: Scheduled time: noon. I arrived in the town at the foot of Melromarc Castle without a hitch. Using a portal, of course.

By now, my Father may have encountered the Siltvelt army. Since it’s unclear exactly where they plan to halt the Siltvelt army’s advance, my Father was lamenting that it would be tough for me to catch up to them later. I hope they can settle things through negotiations…

Come to think of it, I did see a large army heading toward Siltvelt. I could have taken them out, but since that might have been a unit defending the country—which would have disregarded my Father’s most basic wish—I let them pass.
“We won’t forgive the wise king’s folly or the Three Heroes Church’s atrocities!”
“““We won’t forgive them!”””
“This is no time for us to be fighting the Demi-Humans!”
“‘“No time for that!”’”

It seemed a demonstration was taking place in the square surrounding the castle gates. Soldiers are pointing their weapons at each other, glaring. It also appears that movement restrictions have been imposed throughout the castle town. Makeshift barriers resembling checkpoints have been set up in various locations.

Is this all part of preparing for war? Barriers that were originally meant to protect the country are now nothing more than obstacles to stop the people’s revolution. Access to the noble districts and areas near the nation’s key facilities is strictly controlled, with soldiers keeping a close watch.

If I were to show up here, as the Spear Hero—an ally of the Shield Hero—it would surely accelerate the revolution. If that happened, Filolial-sama’s egg would be destroyed. I absolutely must prevent that.

I’ll ride on Yuki-chan’s back and make my way across the rooftops of the stone buildings. An alarm went off along the way, but it stopped almost immediately. That’s probably because they know I’m coming.
A guard is scanning the area and smirking. I’ll wipe that smirk right off his face in a moment.
And so we arrived at the church housing the Dragon Hourglass, situated on a hilltop in the town below Melromarc Castle. I climbed down from Yuki-chan’s back and stroked both her and Kou’s faces.
“They’re hiding just as we planned.”
“But Motoyasu-sama—”
“Otherwise, there’d be no point in me coming here. You understand that, don’t you, Yuki-chan?”
“Yes… Motoyasu-sama, I wish you the best of luck.”
“Kitamura. Good luck!”
I gave a thumbs-up and headed toward the Dragon Hourglass.

Upon entering the church, I found the three followers of the Three Heroes Church standing in a circle around the Dragon Hourglass. A crowd had also gathered on the second floor of the atrium, and the air was thick with killing intent.
“You’ve appeared, haven’t you? You false hero who usurps the title of the Spear God who defends the Shield.”

The one at the front was the pig in charge, wasn’t he? The priest behind him addressed me. These guys were publicly executed in the future, weren’t they? Oh? Wasn’t the pig sacrificed to the Pig King of Faubrey? I’d forgotten.

Behind him stands the Pope, holding a replica weapon. He’s looking at me with a cheerful smile—the kind that wouldn’t hurt a fly. Further back, a wooden crate containing Filolial-sama’s egg is placed in plain sight, as if it were a hostage.
They’re flaunting it as if to say they could destroy it at any moment if I make a wrong move. Guh… At this rate, I can’t even move freely.
“Well then… shall we have a little chat? Our God is a merciful one, Spear Hero.”
The Pope spoke, still smiling.

“If you do so now, we can still forgive you. If you swear here and now to bring us the head of the Shield Demon, we’ll be spared from having to resort to extreme measures. Would you not be willing to cooperate with us in purifying both the Shield Demon, who has ravaged the country in this manner, and those who have been tainted by him?”

“Unfortunately, I cannot accept that proposal. Father is completely innocent. And it is you—who hold the mistaken belief that tormenting Father is the right thing to do—who should give up everything here and die for the sake of the world.”
At my reply, the Pope placed a hand on his head as if in despair and shook his head.

“How very unfortunate. It seems the Spear Hero has been brainwashed by the Shield Demon. Let’s set him free right away. Along with the foolish Bow Hero who lost to the Shield Demon and the Sword Heroes who abandoned their mission—and who have already been dealt with—let’s have you all vanish from this world once and for all.”
“Oh my, are you done with me too, Itsuki?”
“That one is not our god. He’s a foolish demon who presumes to be a god.”
Say whatever you like. It reminds me of the first world. To them, any Hero who gets in their way is a demon, and they claim they were used and deceived.

Judging by the conversation just now, it seems he thinks Ren has already been dealt with as well. Judging by the fact that the loop hasn’t restarted, it seems Ren barely managed to escape with his life. I’ll take a stance with my spear pointed forward.
“If you make a wrong move, I won’t be responsible for whatever happens to our sacrifice.”
The Pope points his weapon at the wooden box containing the egg.
“Guh…”

I can’t move like this. If I make a wrong move, the eggs will be smashed right before my eyes. I absolutely cannot let that happen. Just then, the Three Heroes Church members surrounding me cast Magic to secretly check my level.
Normally, while I’m peddling, I forcefully hide it with Magic, but I don’t know what might happen if I move carelessly. So I’ve stopped blocking them.
“Analysis complete! Level… 300!? Y-you monster!”

The Three Heroes Church members around me let out cries of shock and look around in disbelief. I started out strong anyway, and my level shot up in the blink of an eye while I was leveling up Yuki-chan and the others over and over. Well, my actual strength certainly isn’t limited to just 300, though.
It seems even the Pope can’t hide his surprise at how high my level is. Well, I’ve slaughtered every assassin without exception, and I’m no longer hiding my strength anyway.

“Now then… everyone, cast the sealing Magic on the fake hero who’s collaborating with the Demon of the Shield. You, the fake Spear Hero… understand that if you make a wrong move, those pitiful new lives will meet a tragic end.”
I’ve been made to stand before the Dragon Hourglass, and the Level Reset Ceremony is underway. Soon, my level will be reset to 1.
“Once the level reset is complete, you’ll release the egg, won’t you?”
“Very well. In the name of God, I promise that. Even if the opponent is an impostor claiming to be a god… or even a demon, we must be merciful. Otherwise… right?”
His manner is gentle, but will this promise ever be kept? I’ve secretly… begun a certain plan. I intended to do so from the start, after all.
“Here and now, there is one who unleashes his power to choose a new path. World, grant him this opportunity to show him the way.”
The sand in the Dragon Hourglass glows and resets my level. Now my level has dropped back to 1. Since I no longer meet the level requirements, my weapon has reverted to a Small Spear.
“So, as promised, you’ll release Filolial-sama’s egg, won’t you?”
“Yes… I promise. After you’ve vanished from this world!”

The Pope is aiming his copy weapon at me and preparing to unleash a Brionac. At the same time, the Three Heroes Church followers have begun chanting Ceremonial Magic. Given the range of the spell, I can’t cast Judgment. At best… well, whatever they cast, it’s meaningless against me.
So the Pope really did intend to break his promise after all. But… it’s completely pointless. I started running toward the Pope.
“The sin of impersonating God is grave. Vanish for the sake of the world!”

The Pope unleashed Brionac at me. A powerful beam of light hurtled toward me. But I lightly deflected that Brionac with my spear, sending it crashing into the other members of the Three Heroes Church instead.
“Wh—”

In that brief moment when he was frozen in shock, I closed the distance to the Pope in an instant, grabbed him by the collar, pointed my spear toward the Three Heroes Church member who was holding the egg hostage, and cast my Skills.
“Aiming Lancer X!”

I aimed roughly, but I focused my concentration on making sure not to leave even a single scratch on the wooden crate containing the egg. The spear flew from my hand, piercing the Three Heroes Church member standing near the wooden crate and finishing him off.
“W-what the hell! How can a Level 1 be this strong!?”
“Your downfall was focusing solely on my level.”
Well, I’d used Magic to hide my detailed stats, but it seems that just seeing me at Level 1 made these guys certain of victory. There are actually quite a few secrets behind this.

First, before my level reset, I went all out applying the base stat increases from the “Aptitude Enhancement” method in the weapon enhancement menu. Aptitude refers to the ability gains you get when you level up. The base value, on the other hand, is a separate number you have right now.

In other words, it’s the part that isn’t reset even at Level 1… the numbers like +50. Ultimately, it falls slightly short of the gains from “Talent” boosts, but it’s still a significant factor. After all, boosting “Talent” consumes a lot of levels.

However, if you combine it with raising the base values, you can rack up a decent number of points. The Three Heroes Church, despite worshipping the Four Holy Heroes, doesn’t really know the ins and outs of a hero’s stats. Or rather, even if they did know, they probably didn’t understand the full potential.

Furthermore, anticipating a level reset, I’ve been strengthening the Small Spear to the absolute limit. Through various fusions and enhancements, I’ve turned it into an astonishing weapon capable of unleashing considerable power even at Level 1. Just analyzing Itsuki and the forge isn’t nearly enough to stop me or my Father.

With a thud, the Three Heroes Church cultist standing near the wooden crate collapsed. It’s still hard to say we’re completely safe, but I think we’ve found a way out to some extent. Now, all that’s left is to take down the leader of these fanatics with their twisted ideology.
“Let me go! Servant of the Devil!”
It seems he transformed his copy weapon into a sword—presumably for close combat—in response to me grabbing him by the collar.
“I’ll let you go—so I can unleash my Skills!”

I hurled the Pope into the air and impaled him, just like last time. The Pope seemed to be desperately trying to block my thrust, but it pierced right through his copy weapon and drove right into him.
“Guh!? O, God—”
That again? I’d like to see a little more variety.
“Burst Lance X”
Since I’m just as powerful as Brionac, I unleashed Burst Lance X on him. The tip of the spear exploded, and the Pope was obliterated without a trace.
“His Holiness, defeated so easily…”
“N-no, His Holiness is only pretending to be defeated. He’ll descend upon this land again soon! Everyone, pray!”
These guys always do the exact same thing. After securing the wooden crate, I… well, it’s a hassle, but this is a critical facility, after all. I’d better not go overboard with my big moves.
“The crime of taking Filolial-sama’s egg hostage is a grave one. You lot… I’ll personally send you all to the afterlife!”
I’ll wipe you all out with the Aiming Lancer, the Windmill, and a few thrusts thrown in!
“Consider this a souvenir from the afterlife! You lot are the ones who’ll be following the Pope next!”
“‘Ooogggghhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh!’”
“‘Gyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!’”
The death cries of the pigs and the members of the Three Heroes Church echoed throughout the building housing the Dragon Hourglass.
